byaco5VebkRsEtieGQ_GiQ.zh: 中國今年4-6月報告78例,其中廣東省今年截至5月報告36例。該國去年截至12/4累計報告2萬9,497例,曾於廣東省佛山去年7月爆發之大規模疫情已於11月受到控制(累計2萬5,826例)。 菲律賓薩馬省(Samar)疫情上升,今年2/5-7/13累計報告329例疑病例,疫情高峰落於第26週,病患分布以巴塞(Basey)和甘達拉(Gandara)鎮為多,年齡集中於10-29歲,該國近期已展開社區衛教活動。 法屬圭亞那疫情擴張,今年截至7/16累計報告1,157例確定病例,其中2例死亡,且有210例極可能或確定病例住院,並有出現母子垂直感染之案例,病例在部分醫院占其急診就診數的4-6%,疫情高峰落於4月底至5月中,惟近期可能有通報延遲之情形,當局已發布警報。
byaco5VebkRsEtieGQ_GiQ.en: China reported 78 cases in April to June this year, of which Guangdong Province reported 36 as of May. The country had reported 29,497 cases as of 4 December last year. A large-scale outbreak in Foshan, Guangdong, which began in July last year, was brought under control in November (25,826 cases cumulatively). In Samar Province, Philippines, cases are rising. From 5 February to 13 July this year, 329 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively. The peak fell in week 26, cases are concentrated in the towns of Basey and Gandara, and most patients are aged 10 to 29 years. The country has recently launched community health education activities. In French Guiana, the outbreak is expanding. As of 16 July this year, 1,157 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Of the probable or confirmed cases, 210 were hospitalized, and cases of vertical mother-to-child transmission have been reported. In some hospitals, cases account for 4–6% of emergency department visits. The peak fell between late April and mid-May, but reporting may have been delayed recently, and authorities have issued an alert.

WteoSdQigLO3SgaQtHaPfw.zh: 法屬圭亞那疫情持續,自今年 1 月下旬迄今累計報告509例確診病例,疫情已由西部沿海地區蔓延至其他地區,美國CDC近期提升法屬圭亞那疫情旅遊警示至第2級。
WteoSdQigLO3SgaQtHaPfw.en: The outbreak in French Guiana continues. Since late January this year, 509 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and the outbreak has spread from western coastal areas to other regions. The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the French Guiana outbreak to Level 2.

9_xXYZOIVaqv0HW68lFe6Q.zh: 法屬圭亞那於今年 1 月下旬報告自 2014 年以來首次發生本土確診病例,迄今累計 108 例確診病例,主要分布於西部沿海地區(82%),已有 30 例住院病例。
9_xXYZOIVaqv0HW68lFe6Q.en: In late January this year, French Guiana reported its first locally acquired confirmed case since 2014. So far, 108 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, mainly in the western coastal area (82%), and 30 cases have been hospitalised.

ry_nxld2eDtIwr5zilOlCQ.zh: 法屬圭亞那於今年1月下旬報告自2014年以來首次發生本土病例,截至3/22累計65例確診病例,近期仍持續有病例發生,其中88%分布於西部沿海地區。 蘇利南自今年1月宣布爆發疫情以來,病例數明顯上升,已逾1,357例檢驗陽性及1例死亡,病例分布於該國8個行政區。當局表示病例數低估,並預期疫情可能隨著雨季到來而上升。
ry_nxld2eDtIwr5zilOlCQ.en: French Guiana reported its first locally acquired cases since 2014 in late January this year. As of 22 March, 65 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, and cases continue to occur; 88% are distributed along the western coast. Suriname has seen a marked rise in cases since it declared an outbreak in January this year, with more than 1,357 test-positive cases and 1 death reported, distributed across eight administrative districts. Authorities say case numbers are underestimated and expect the outbreak may rise with the arrival of the rainy season.

m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.zh: 聖露西亞報告自2021年以來首例確診病例,該患者住院4天並接受支持性照護後,已完全康復,目前國內尚未發現其他病例。美洲包括古巴、法屬圭亞那、蓋亞那及蘇利南等地疫情持續,不同地區間人口流動且當地存在病媒蚊,造成該國仍有病例發生風險。
m9IF9Lp8K8FKKy-8jY_ONg.en: Saint Lucia has reported its first confirmed case since 2021. The patient was hospitalized for 4 days, received supportive care and has fully recovered; no other cases have been found in the country so far. Outbreaks continue in the Americas, including Cuba, French Guiana, Guyana and Suriname. Population movement between different areas, together with the presence of vector mosquitoes, means the country still faces a risk of cases.

MCFQX-nUYICA4vbIj0-rrQ.zh: 泛美衛生組織(PAHO)於2/11發布警報,對於美洲數國自去年底迄今年初之疫情上升,建議各國加強監測、臨床及病媒蚊管制。全球去年1/1-12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,其中,美洲報告313,132例病例(113,926例確診)及170例死亡,多國/地區自去年底疫情持續上升,且於近年無疫情發生之地區再次出現本地傳播病例,如蓋亞那、法屬圭亞那及蘇利南等國。
MCFQX-nUYICA4vbIj0-rrQ.en: The Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) issued an alert on 11 February about rising outbreaks in several countries in the Americas since late last year and early this year, recommending strengthened surveillance, clinical management and vector mosquito control. Globally, from 1 January to 10 December last year, 41 countries and regions reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. Of these, the Americas reported 313,132 cases (113,926 confirmed) and 170 deaths. Many countries have seen outbreaks continue to rise since late last year, and locally transmitted cases have reappeared in areas without outbreaks in recent years, such as Guyana, French Guiana and Suriname.

exxpzu7ch9bG1v2Fb8J3_Q.zh: 法屬圭亞那報告自2014年以來首例本土病例,個案近期無旅遊史,1/21檢驗陽性,病毒目前仍於印度洋地區傳播,2025年4月曾報告由印度洋地區返回之病例。outbreaknewstoday 1/30 蘇利南疫情上升,報告134例病例及1例死亡,主要分布於45-64歲(38 例病例)及25-44歲族群(27例病例),為該國相隔約10年後再次發生疫情。當局推估首批病例發生於去年12月,預計感染高峰將持續3到4個月
exxpzu7ch9bG1v2Fb8J3_Q.en: French Guiana reported its first locally acquired case since 2014. The patient had no recent travel history and tested positive on 21 January. The virus is still circulating in the Indian Ocean region, and a case returning from that region was reported in April 2025 (source: Outbreak News Today, 30 January). Suriname's outbreak is growing, with 134 cases and 1 death reported. Most cases are in the 45–64 age group (38 cases) and 25–44 age group (27 cases). This is the country's first outbreak in about 10 years. Authorities estimate the first cases occurred in December last year and expect the peak of infections to last 3 to 4 months.

RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.
